videos.title: Dermalogica Clarifying Body Spray, 295 mL: After the Shower or the Gym #shorts
videos.lead: Dermalogica clarifying body spray in the larger 295 mL size, in under a minute: when to use it and how, from the Westville body care desk.
facts: Blemish-fighting body spray that helps clear clogged pores and minimize future body breakouts
Salicylic acid (1.0%) exfoliates; witch hazel, tea tree oil and Moroccan argan oil help balance oil and reduce redness
Ideal after the shower, post-workout or on the go; the mist disperses even upside down
Spray onto clean, dry skin from about a foot and a half away; let it sink in 30-60 seconds; AM and/or PM

scenes.say: Westville body care: the bigger bottle. Dermalogica clarifying body spray, two hundred ninety-five milliliters.

scenes.headline: After the shower or the gym
scenes.say: The listing names three moments for it: after the shower, after a workout, or on the go.

scenes.headline: Sprays even upside down
scenes.say: The mist even disperses upside down, so hard-to-reach spots like the back are covered.

scenes.headline: Salicylic acid + botanicals
scenes.say: Salicylic acid exfoliates, while witch hazel, tea tree oil and argan oil help balance oil and reduce redness.

scenes.headline: Morning, night, or both
scenes.say: Cleanse first, spray onto clean, dry skin, and give it thirty to sixty seconds before getting dressed.
Clarifying body spray, the two hundred ninety-five milliliter size. The link is in the description.

videos.title: Dermalogica Phyto Nature Firming Serum: Don't Skip the Neck #shorts
videos.lead: Dermalogica phyto nature firming serum, 40 mL, in under a minute: a dual-phase serum the listing says to smooth over the face and neck, from the Westville body care desk.
facts: Dual-phase serum: highly active botanicals with biomimetic technology to reduce visible signs of skin aging
Flash-firms, lifts and revitalizes, per the listing
Dispense 1-2 pumps, blend the two serums in the palm, smooth over cleansed face and neck; morning and/or evening; follow with moisturizer

scenes.say: Westville body care usually starts below the neck. Tonight, a serum that goes right there: Dermalogica phyto nature firming serum.

scenes.headline: Flash-firms, lifts, revitalizes
scenes.say: The listing calls it a dual-phase serum that flash-firms, lifts and revitalizes, to reduce visible signs of aging.

scenes.headline: Blend in your palm
scenes.say: There are two serums in one bottle. Dispense one to two pumps and blend them in your palm.

scenes.headline: Botanicals at work
scenes.say: Inside are botanicals, including camu camu, Moroccan rockrose and Madagascar green coffee bean.

scenes.headline: Face and neck
scenes.say: Smooth it over a cleansed face and neck, morning or evening, then follow with your moisturizer.
Phyto nature firming serum, forty milliliters. The link is in the description.

videos.title: Dermalogica Dynamic Skin Recovery SPF50, 50 mL: Polypeptides + White Tea #shorts

facts: 3-in-1 daily moisturizer that visibly firms, hydrates and protects with Broad Spectrum SPF50
Polypeptide blend helps improve the appearance of photoaged skin; White Tea gives antioxidant protection against free radicals
Non-greasy formula blends into skin for a flawless finish
After cleansing and toning, apply a generous amount to face and neck, preferably 30 minutes before sun exposure

scenes.say: Cape Town daily sun care: the full-size bottle of Dermalogica dynamic skin recovery SPF fifty, fifty milliliters.

scenes.headline: Polypeptides + white tea
scenes.say: A polypeptide blend helps improve the look of photoaged skin, and white tea gives antioxidant protection against free radicals.

scenes.headline: Non-greasy, sheer finish
scenes.say: The formula is non-greasy and blends into the skin for a flawless finish.

scenes.headline: The final morning step
scenes.say: It goes on after cleansing and toning, a generous amount over the face and neck.

scenes.headline: About 30 minutes before the sun
scenes.say: The listing says to apply it, preferably, thirty minutes before sun exposure.
Dynamic skin recovery SPF fifty, the fifty milliliter size. The link is in the description.

videos.title: Dermalogica BioLumin-C Night Restore Serum: Sun Care Ends at Sunset? #shorts
videos.lead: Dermalogica biolumin-c night restore serum, 25 mL, in under a minute: the night step the listing says helps reverse daytime damage, from the Cape Town daily sun care desk.
facts: Night serum that helps restore radiance, hydration and tone overnight
Ultra-stable vitamin C and a pro-vitamin D complex help repair the moisture barrier during sleep; helps reverse daytime damage
After cleansing and toning, apply 3-4 drops over face and neck before bed; keep out of eyes

scenes.say: Cape Town daily sun care, after dark: Dermalogica biolumin-c night restore serum.

scenes.headline: Helps reverse daytime damage
scenes.say: SPF is the daytime job. At night, the listing says, skin enters a regenerative phase, and this serum helps reverse daytime damage.

scenes.headline: Vitamin C + pro-vitamin D
scenes.say: Inside: ultra-stable vitamin C and a pro-vitamin D complex, to help repair the moisture barrier while you sleep.

scenes.headline: 3-4 drops before bed
scenes.say: After cleansing and toning, apply three to four drops over the face and neck before bed, keeping it out of the eyes.

scenes.headline: Back to SPF
scenes.say: Then in the morning, it's back to a broad spectrum SPF.
Biolumin-c night restore serum, twenty-five milliliters. The link is in the description.
